This feels right. The tag suggestions are simple and clear, and clicking an existing tag is exactly what I pictured.

The duplicate recognition is reassuring, not annoying. The message makes it clear that I’m updating the existing bookmark, and keeping a single copy is important to me.

I like having the “Read later” marker on the main card as well as eventually having a separate unread view—it gives useful context without getting in the way. The preview thumbnail is also about the right size: visible enough to help recognition but not so large that it overwhelms the title and description.

These changes satisfy what I was looking for in the saving flow.
